title: content-check-v1
description: Printed by `content-check --json`: one JSON line with the problems the text form lists. file is the leading path of a problem line (null when the line names none); the whole line is file + ": " + message, or message alone. count is the full count; problems holds at most the first 200; truncated says whether more exist. law_package is the informational law-package line (null when campaign.json is absent or unreadable). no_content is present, true, only when the campaign has no content/ directory. Read-only; not a publication approval or legal review.
